summary: adapter.py: deterministic TDD lifecycle adapter; prepare requires hidden_state=false, no shell registry, declared slice, nonempty contract_hash+validator_hash, then yields prepared non-authoritative run; mandatory Skill input receipt gate binds context artifact/hash; transitions RED->GREEN->REFACTOR strictly ordered with exit-code and allowed-path checks, producing blocked diagnostics on violations; RED allows tests/docs and declared failure, GREEN production only/pass, REFACTOR declared production/tests/docs/pass; finalize_candidate only after exact lifecycle and never authorizes acceptance/handoff/release; resume rejects identity drift and stale/failed/superseded runs; stage binding validates one context+attempt per stage, matching IDs and non-authoritative decision, returns hashes; protocol persistence validates schema/store/path containment/no links/reparse points/complete ordered immutable artifacts, permits listed observation files, rejects conflicts/undeclared files; execute requires new run directory, receipt-gated prepare, processes events, requires protocol bundle+store together, persists recovery-state with hashes and no authorizations; ambiguity: execute creates run_dir before validation and may leave it after blocked/error, making retries require successor.
